c0721: Most health departments want a plan review of your layout and equipment BEFORE you build out; a bar with a kitchen gets a food establishment permit and an inspection before opening. UK: register your food business with the council at least 28 days before you start (free) and expect a Food Hygiene Rating (0-5) after inspection in England, Wales and Northern Ireland; Scotland uses FHIS (Pass / Improvement Required)
c0874: ASCAP / BMI / SESAC music licenses if you play music in the bar
c0094: You pay for the space from the day you sign. These months are a startup cost: they do NOT overlap the P&L, which starts on opening day. If your liquor license is likely to take longer than the build-out (often 3-12 months from signing), enter the months until it is issued, or negotiate a license contingency and rent abatement in the lease.
